study: Family005 mixed moments and Taylor-contact cancellation

conventions.domains: i,j are nonnegative integers unless an extension is stated explicitly
conventions.central_kernel: c_(a/2)=0 for negative or odd integer a
conventions.negative_moment: m_(-1)=0 only as an explicit convention in recurrences

theorems.title: Absolute integrability of M
hypotheses: P and Q are real polynomials
f(t) is the positive square root of 1-t^2 for -1<t<1
theorems.conclusion: The absolute integral of |t| P(t) Q(s) / (f(t)(1-ts)) over (-1,1) x (0,1) is finite; both integration orders agree.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Absolute integrability of Z
hypotheses: D and Q are real polynomials
theorems.conclusion: The absolute integral of D(t) Q(s)/(1-ts) over (0,1)^2 is finite; both integration orders agree.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Central binomial recurrence and generating series

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Rational one variable moments
theorems.conclusion: m_i=0 for odd i and 2/((i+1)c_(i/2)) for even i; (i+1)m_i=i*m_(i-2) for i>=1; m_i tends to 0.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: M moment series
theorems.conclusion: M(i,j)=sum_(u>=0) m_(i+u)/(j+u+1), with absolute justification of the signed geometric expansion.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: M diagonal recurrence and reduction
theorems.conclusion: M(i,j)-M(i+1,j+1)=m_i/(j+1); finite iteration gives the two diagonal-reduction formulas in study.md section 6.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Harmonic evaluation of Z
theorems.conclusion: Z(i,i)=zeta(2)-H_i^(2); for i!=j, Z(i,j)=(H_i-H_j)/(i-j).

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: M boundary recurrences
theorems.conclusion: d*Kminus_d=(d-1)*Kminus_(d-2)+m_(d-2)+m_(d-1); Kminus_1=2; (d-1)*Kplus_d=(d-2)*Kplus_(d-2)+2/(d-1).

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified
ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Zeta boundary start
theorems.conclusion: M(0,1)=(3/2)*zeta(2), by the nonnegative integral -2*integral_0^1 log(x)/(1-x^2) dx.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.kind: source result; shorter independent direct-integral proof

theorems.title: Optional pi evaluation
hypotheses: pi and arcsin have their usual real analytic meanings
theorems.conclusion: M(0,1)=pi^2/4 and hence zeta(2)=pi^2/6.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Rational boundary arrays and closed forms
hypotheses: the arrays satisfy the source boundary recurrences
Hstar_z=c_(z/2) for even z and 1/(z*c_((z-1)/2)) for odd z
theorems.conclusion: The arrays are uniquely rational; Hstar_(z+2)/Hstar_z=(z+1)/(z+2); the three finite closed-form sums in study.md section 9 hold, including empty sums.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Universal M decomposition
hypotheses: M0 is the rational diagonal-reduction array
c_(a/2)=0 if the integer a is negative or odd
theorems.conclusion: M(i,j)=M0(i,j)+4G*c_((i-j)/2)+(3/2)*zeta(2)*c_((j-i-1)/2). No uniqueness or independence of real constants is asserted.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Exact polynomial defect identity
theorems.conclusion: M(P,j)-(3/2)Z(D,j)=A_j+B_j*G+(3/2)*E_j*zeta(2), with A_j=sum_i p_i*M0(i,j)-(3/2)*sum_i d_i*Z0(i,j), B_j=4*sum_(r>=0)p_(j+2r)c_r, E_j=[t^j](tP/sqrt(1-t^2)-D).

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.kind: generalized reusable extraction with independent proof

theorems.title: Analytic contact and finite jet vanishing
hypotheses: F is analytic in a real neighborhood of zero
theorems.conclusion: F(t)=O(t^L) as t tends to zero iff its Taylor coefficients in degrees less than L vanish; one-sided contact suffices as well.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Rational polynomial Taylor contact cancellation
hypotheses: tP(t)/sqrt(1-t^2)-D(t)=O(t^L) as t tends to zero
theorems.conclusion: There are explicitly specified rational A_j,B_j such that M(P,j)-(3/2)Z(D,j)=A_j+B_j*G.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.kind: main generalized extraction; ordinary proof completed

theorems.title: Polynomial test function cancellation
hypotheses: the finite pairing sum_j coefficient(Q,j)*E_j equals zero
theorems.conclusion: M(P,Q)-(3/2)Z(D,Q) belongs to Q+QG. In particular contact of order L and degree(Q)<L imply this conclusion.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Unique contact truncation
theorems.conclusion: The unique degree-less-than-L D with contact order at least L is the degree-less-than-L truncation of tP/sqrt(1-t^2). All polynomial solutions differ from it by a multiple of t^L.

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Exact rational series tail bound
theorems.conclusion: The tail after N terms of the M series lies between zero and max(1,(i+N)/(j+N+1))*(m_(i+N-2)+m_(i+N-1)).

proof.status: ordinary mathematical proof provided; not Lean verified

theorems.title: Coefficient field extension
hypotheses: K is a subfield of R
the same integer-index and Taylor-contact hypotheses as MM016 hold
theorems.conclusion: M(P,j)-(3/2)Z(D,j) belongs to K+K*G.
